name: EPIC 229048388

text.card: A red giant 6,116 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.12 solar masses and 12.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,932 K at its surface.
